Victoria’s Secret Gift Card?
By picking a Victoria’s Secret Gift Card, you can be sure that the recipient will have easy access to lingerie, sleepwear, and women’s apparel.
What are the available denominations of Victoria’s Secret Gift Cards?
On GyFTR, you will find Victoria’s Secret Gift Cards in various denominations to suit your purchase requirements. The denominations of Gift Cards are subject to change based on availability.
Is It a Physical Gift Card?
No, the Victoria’s Secret Gift Cards are not physical. You will receive your Gift Card via SMS, WhatsApp, and email.
How Many Times Can Victoria’s Secret Gift Cards Be Used?
Victoria’s Secret Gift Cards can be used/redeemed only once.
